domains.name: Objects in sleeping area
domains.summary: Indicates whether objects were tangled around, on top of, under the child, or if their position is unknown.

domains.name: Environmental conditions
domains.summary: Records outside temperature and overcrowding in the home/living space.

domains.name: Overheating factors
domains.summary: Indicates if the child was overheated, whether due to room being too hot or excessive bedding/clothing.

domains.name: Sleeping accessories
domains.summary: Records use of a pacifier and presence/position of pillows, sleep positioners, toys, and other objects in the sleeping area.

domains.name: Shared sleeping surface
domains.summary: Indicates if an adult was present on the same sleeping surface as the child and their relationship to the child.

domains.name: Product details
domains.summary: Describes the product involved in the incident, its safety label status, and whether it was used properly.

domains.name: Crime type
domains.summary: Identifies if the death is related to prostitution, robbery/burglary, sexual assault, or witness intimidation.

domains.name: Sleeping location
domains.summary: Details where the child was found sleeping at the time of death and usual sleep place.
